title: Market validation
summary: Test a product opportunity with explicit evidence and uncertainty.
entryConditions: A target user or buyer and a problem hypothesis are stated
steps: Describe the ICP segments, problem, alternatives, and assumptions, and state success and stop conditions before results (ah-define-opportunity)
Choose an ethical research or experiment method
Collect observations and record sample, context, and limitations with pseudonymous ids (ah-record-market-evidence); capture single-account buyer signals separately (ah-capture-buyer-signal)
Compare results with the pre-stated success or stop conditions (ah-assess-market-fit)
Recommend proceed, revise, investigate further, or stop with an explicit claim level; a person records the go decision
Run market check after each change
outputs: Evidence log with sample and limitations (evidence.md)
Fit assessment with recommendation, claim level, and human decision (fit-assessment.md)

methods.name: Lean Startup
methods.use: Optional hypothesis, experiment, and learning framing

methods.name: Jobs to Be Done
methods.use: Optional lens for interview and opportunity framing
